title: S119 11.5 LIST Command and Other Users' Namespace
parent_path: S119 11.5 LIST Command and Other Users' Namespace

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In response to a LIST command containing an argument of the Other Users' Namespace prefix, a server MUST NOT list users that have not granted list access to their personal mailboxes to the currently authenticated user.
statements.pre_cond: protocol.state = Authenticated & command.type = LIST & command.argument = OtherUsersNamespacePrefix
